name: Barnaby's Traveling Trade
description: A cheerful merchant leads a heavily laden pony along the road. He waves enthusiastically as he sees you.

approach.text: 'Greetings! I'm Barnaby. I've got everything a traveler needs to stay fed, warm, and mostly alive! Care to trade?'

npcs.name: Barnaby Wynn
npcs.title: Wandering Merchant
npcs.description: A cheerful, road-worn human leading a heavily laden pony. His pack overflows with rations, torches, and odds and ends from across the kingdoms.

greeting.first_time: Greetings! I'm Barnaby. I've got everything a traveler needs to stay fed, warm, and mostly alive! Care to trade?
greeting.returning: Back so soon? My pony will be glad of the rest. What'll it be?

main_menu.text: What can I get for you today?

options.label: [Wizard/Sorcerer] Any reagents for a fellow seeker of knowledge?
[Paladin/Cleric] Any holy icons or blessed supplies?

browse_shop.text: Rations, torches, and a few odds and ends for the spell-minded. Take a look!

arcane_talk.text: A spellcaster! I keep a little arcane powder tucked away for folk like you. Have a look.

holy_talk.text: Always room for the divine! There's blessed incense in the pack, if you know what to do with it.

sell_items.text: Got something to lighten your pack? My pony won't thank you, but I will.

goodbye.text: Safe travels, friend! May your boots never wear thin!
